dedupe_keys.name: coep replication package for greenhouse gases resulting from grid connected electricity demand version 1

description: COEP Replication Package for "Greenhouse Gases Resulting from Grid-Connected Electricity Demand" Version 1 is a data set deposited in ICPSR by its authors Karl Dunkle Werner, Arik Levinson (Independent Researcher). Many businesses would like to claim their electricity use results in no greenhouse gases. Because electricity cannot be traced from specific generators to purchasers, regulators and users propose an approximation. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and ICPSR normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-icpsr-repository.
